description: Everything an agent needs to write, consume and ship C and C++ builds with CMake: the cmake-build rule (the configure gate spelled per CMake line, version floors and policies, the CMake language traps, module authoring, targets and linkage, install and export with CPS on 4.3 and later, dependency acquisition across find_package, FetchContent, CPM and providers, toolchain files, CTest, presets and CI, and the wrapped side of a Bazel rules_foreign_cc build), the cpp-packaging rule (one manager of record, Conan 2 recipes, profiles and lockfiles, vcpkg manifests, baselines, ports and binary caching), plus the cmake-dependency-triage skill that answers which copy and version of a dependency was resolved and why, and the cmake-modernize skill that takes a legacy tree to target-based and consumable.
name: cmake-essentials
summary: The CMake and C++ package-management set — build-file standards for CMake 3.25 through 4.4, the Conan 2 and vcpkg manifest rules, and the dependency-triage and modernisation procedures
